description: This file defines a MailchimpService class for initializing a Mailchimp client and provides an exported function to subscribe an email to a newsletter list using Mailchimp API.

classes.name: MailchimpService
classes.description: A class that initializes and provides a Mailchimp client instance.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new Mailchimp client instance using the API key.
